伏击时造成_50%额外伤害_。: Deals _50% extra damage_ on surprise attacks.

Reading only applies blindness and paralysis to targets in your field of view, without dealing damage or blinding or weakening the reader. The base duration of each effect is _10 turns × your missing-health fraction_, calculated as (maximum HP − current HP) ÷ maximum HP.

For example, at 50% HP both effects last 5 turns; at 10% HP they last 9 turns. At full HP no effects are applied. Target resistances and immunities still apply.
